BAY PROCEDURE Tacoma RV Center · Document Library CONCERN Furrion FACT12SA2 rooftop shows E3 MODEL Furrion FACT12SA2 DATE 2026-10-09 WO# - PRIMARY Resecure the FACT12 freeze sensor on the evaporator coil. VISUAL FLOWCHART FACT12 shows E2 or E3. Is the freeze sensor loose or off the coil? Replace the freeze sensor and retest. Resecure the freeze sensor on the evaporator coil. Is the code still present? Replace the freeze sensor and retest. The code cleared. That is the correction. YES NO NO YES BAY PROCEDURE Bay order · Tacoma RV Center WHAT THIS PATTERN USUALLY MEANS A FACT12 E2 or E3 is a freeze-sensor seating fault. Resecure the freeze sensor on the evaporator coil before any board swap. If the code is still present after that, replace the freeze sensor. BAY ORDER (DO THIS FIRST) 1. On a FACT12 E2 or E3, find the freeze sensor on the evaporator coil. If it is loose or off the coil, do the seating correction next. If it is already seated, go to the replace step. 2. Resecure the freeze sensor on the evaporator coil. Do not replace the control board first. If the code clears, that is the confirmed correction. 3. If the sensor is seated and the code remains, replace the freeze sensor and retest. Do not replace the control board first. DO NOT - Do not replace the control board before the freeze sensor is resecured. SOURCES (SHOP DOCUMENT LIBRARY) - Furrion CCD-0008666 (FACR08 manual, closest reference) page 5
